subject: world_language
concept: Writing a professional report or proposal with appropriate structure and register in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR C1 'well-structured professional writing' descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans a report/proposal using a structured professional-document organizer in the target language
exercise.abstract: Student writes a professional report or proposal with clear structure and appropriate register in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: document has clear sections, professional register throughout, and a coherent purpose
misconception_flags: writes content that would fit a personal piece rather than a genuinely professional document structure and tone

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
